fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Adversaries may install a root certificate on a compromised system to avoid warnings when connecting to adversary controlled web servers.
fields.name: Root Certificate Installed From Susp Locations
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "Import-Certificate" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -FilePath " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "Cert:\\LocalMachine\\Root") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ":\\Windows\\TEMP\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\Desktop\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\Downloads\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\Perflogs\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ":\\Users\\Public\\")))
